research_mode: official Police.uk API documentation only; crime location, identifier, BTP and no-location semantics; no parcel result or safety score claimed

sources.name: Crimes at published location
verified_claims: the method returns crimes mapped to a specified published location rather than a radius
limitations: the published location itself is approximate

sources.name: Nearest predefined location
verified_claims: latitude-longitude input is resolved to the nearest predefined location
limitations: input coordinates do not force exact incident matching

sources.name: Crime location identifier source
verified_claims: valid location identifiers are returned by other location-bearing methods
limitations: location IDs are map-point identifiers, not property identifiers

sources.name: Approximate street name
verified_claims: street name is a human-readable approximation of where the crime happened
limitations: street label must not be treated as exact address

sources.name: API crime identifier
verified_claims: id relates only to the API
it is not a police identifier
limitations: API IDs must not be represented as source-system crime references

sources.name: Persistent crime identifier
verified_claims: persistent_id is a 64-character unique identifier for the crime
limitations: identifier does not reveal the police reference

sources.name: Non-persistent API id
verified_claims: the ordinary id is not guaranteed to remain the same for a crime
limitations: longitudinal linkage should not rely on ordinary id

sources.name: Latest recorded outcome
verified_claims: outcome_status contains the category and date of the latest recorded outcome
limitations: latest outcome is not a complete outcome history

sources.name: Force/BTP location type
verified_claims: location_type distinguishes normal Force and BTP locations
limitations: location type is not an offence category

sources.name: BTP boundary overlap
verified_claims: BTP locations fall within normal police-force boundaries
limitations: Force and BTP records can coexist geographically

sources.name: BTP location subtype
verified_claims: location_subtype describes the type of BTP location when applicable
limitations: subtype must not be inferred for Force locations

sources.name: Crimes with no mapped location
verified_claims: the method returns crimes that could not be mapped to a location
limitations: unmapped crimes are not zero-location incidents

sources.name: No-location null fields
verified_claims: location and location_type are null for this method
limitations: null location must be retained rather than geocoded by inference

sources.name: No-location filters
verified_claims: requests filter by crime category, force and optional YYYY-MM date
limitations: force/category filters do not recover coordinates

sources.name: Unmapped-crime guard
verified_claims: unmapped records remain valid crime records in the API
limitations: they must not be assigned to parcels or silently dropped from area-level completeness checks
